description: A step-04 requirement that links to a node that does not exist: E700, owned by step 04 (DOC 13.9 row 4).

value.statement: The system shall remember a member's preferred language.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a registered member with a language set, when they sign in, then pages show in that language.
Given a member with no language set, when they sign in, then pages show in the default language.
Given a member who changes the language, when the next page loads, then it shows in the new language.
